description: Removes a hostname so requests to that host no longer serve the site. Inputs: domain, optional slug, and token. When slug is set, the hostname must already be attached to that slug.

slug.description: Optional slug. When set, the hostname must be attached to that slug.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: remove_domain
title: Remove a custom domain
